figures.finding: Dominica's Film Office, under the Discover Dominica Authority, offers a visiting production help with a film licence, work-permit and visa waivers and a duty-free exemption on the goods used for filming; it names no cash rebate, tax credit or film fund.

value.dutyExemption: duty free exemption on all capital and other goods used for filming; waiver of import duties and taxes on equipment and supplies

figures.applies: DM. The legacy Film Trade page is undated (its list of productions ends with 2005-2006 titles); the current discoverdominica.com/film-trade returns 404. No fund, rebate or credit is named; the page does not say that none exists.

sources.said: The Dominica Film Office can offer the following services: assistance with location scouting; identifying and securing locations; assistance with obtaining a film license, work permit exemptions, visa waivers, special import permits for items such as firearms (real or fake), explosives, animals, aerosol, motor vehicles, fresh foods and meats, duty free exemption on all capital and other goods used for filming … The Film Office provides assistance in obtaining a waiver of import duties and taxes on equipment and supplies to be used in production.
